---
title: Merge count tables
description: Combine per-sample HTSeq outputs for downstream analysis.
---

Each scheduler task produces a separate count table. After every task finishes
successfully, merge those tables for downstream analysis:

```bash
htseq-count-cluster merge --directory counts
```

The command writes `counts/merged_counts_table.csv` with:

- `Genes` as the first column;
- sample columns sorted by count-table filename.

Before writing the merged file, HTSeqCountCluster checks that each
`*.counts.tsv` file has:

- two tab-separated columns;
- unique gene identifiers; and
- the same gene order as every other count table.

A mismatch stops the merge instead of silently pairing counts with the wrong
genes.

HTSeq summary rows such as `__no_feature` remain available for downstream
assignment-quality checks.
